ielts.desc:
The International English Language Testing System (IELTS) is the world’s most popular English language proficiency test for higher education and global migration. IELTS was introduced to assess one’s English skills such as Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening.

Developed by some of the world’s leading experts in language assessment, IELTS is jointly managed by University of Cambridge (ESOL Examinations), British Council, IDP Education Australia.

IELTS is the pre requisite test for admission in Universities and colleges in countries like the USA, Australia, Canada, New Zealand, Ireland and the UK. More than 8000 organizations across the globe recognize and accept IELTS scores.
ielts.summary: The world's standard English proficiency test for education and global migration.
ielts.duration: 2 Hours 45 Minutes (plus 10 mins transfer time for paper-based Listening)
ielts.scoring: Band scale from 0 to 9 (overall and per section)
ielts.contactHeading: Would you like to know more about a specific aspect of IELTS, such as test preparation tips, score requirements for different countries, or differences between Academic and General Training modules?

sections.name: Reading
sections.desc: Reading section takes 60 minutes time in which 40 questions are asked based on 3 reading passages with a total of 2,000 to 2,750 words.

sections.name: Speaking
sections.desc: The speaking module consists of an oral interview between the candidate and examiner, which takes 10-15 min.

sections.name: Writing
sections.desc: In the Writing Section you have to write essays of 2 given tasks in 60 min. Task – 1: You have to write an essay of 150 words in 20 min. Task – 2: You have to write an essay of 250 words in 40 min.

sections.name: Listening
sections.desc: Listening section has 40 questions across 4 sections which need to be completed in 30 minutes. An additional 10 minutes is given to transform the answer to the answer sheet.

highlights: Study Abroad: Most universities and colleges in English-speaking countries require IELTS scores for admission.
Immigration: Many countries use IELTS results as proof of English language proficiency for immigration purposes.
Career Advancement: Employers often prefer candidates with strong English language skills, and IELTS can validate your proficiency.

types.name: IELTS General Training
types.desc: Suitable for those migrating to an English-speaking country or seeking training or work experience.

types.name: IELTS Academic
types.desc: Designed for those planning to study at university or other higher education institutions.

Practice regularly: Familiarize yourself with the test format and question types.
Take mock tests: Simulate exam conditions and identify areas for improvement.
Build Vocabulary: Enhance your word power through reading and practice.
Develop speaking fluency: Practice speaking English with native speakers or language partners.

toefl.fullTitle: Test of English as a Foreign Language (iBT)
toefl.desc: The Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL) is a standardized test that measures the English language ability of non-native speakers wishing to enroll in English-speaking universities. It is one of the most widely accepted English language proficiency tests globally.
toefl.summary: Academic English test highly preferred by institutions in the US and Canada.
toefl.mode: Computer-based (at Test Center or Home Edition)
toefl.scoring: TOEFL scores range from 0 to 120. Each of the four sections is scored from 0 to 30, and the total score is the sum of the four section scores.
toefl.contactHeading: Would you like to know more about specific TOEFL preparation strategies, score requirements for different universities, or the differences between TOEFL and other English proficiency tests?

sections.name: Reading
sections.desc: You’ll read academic passages and answer questions based on the content.

sections.name: Listening
sections.desc: You’ll listen to lectures, conversations, and discussions and answer questions.

sections.name: Speaking
sections.desc: You’ll respond to spoken questions and deliver short talks.

sections.name: Writing
sections.desc: You’ll write an integrated task based on a reading and listening passage, and an independent essay.

highlights: University Admissions: Most universities in English-speaking countries require TOEFL scores for admission into undergraduate and graduate programs.
Scholarships: Many scholarships and fellowships consider TOEFL scores as a criterion for eligibility.
Professional Opportunities: Some employers in international companies may require TOEFL scores as proof of language proficiency.

types.name: TOEFL iBT (Internet-Based Test)
types.desc: The most common format, taken at a test center.

types.name: TOEFL Home Edition

Build vocabulary: Enhance your word power to comprehend complex texts and express ideas effectively.

Take practice tests: Simulate exam conditions and identify areas for improvement.

duolingo.desc:
Duolingo: Gamifying Language Learning

Duolingo is a popular language-learning app that has revolutionized the way people approach language acquisition. It’s designed to make learning fun and engaging through a gamified approach.

How Does It Work?

Duolingo offers a variety of courses in different languages. Users progress through lessons by completing exercises that focus on vocabulary, grammar, pronunciation, and reading comprehension. The app uses a points system and rewards to motivate learners, making the process enjoyable and addictive.
duolingo.summary: Convenient, online, and affordable English proficiency test.
duolingo.scoring: 10 to 160 scale (integrated subscores for Literacy, Comprehension, Conversation, Production)
duolingo.contactHeading: Would you like to know more about Duolingo’s effectiveness, or perhaps compare it to other language learning platforms?

sections.desc: It’s available on both iOS and Android devices, making it convenient to learn on the go.

sections.desc: The core app is free, making it accessible to a wide audience.

sections.name: Engagement
sections.desc: The gamified approach keeps users motivated and interested.

sections.name: Progress tracking
sections.desc: Duolingo provides detailed statistics on learning progress.

highlights: Gamification: Duolingo incorporates game-like elements such as points, streaks, and levels to keep users motivated.
Speech recognition: Users can practice speaking the language through voice exercises.
Bite-sized lessons: Short, focused lessons make it easy to fit language learning into busy schedules.
Writing practice: Duolingo includes writing exercises to improve grammar and vocabulary.
Free access: The core features of Duolingo are available for free.
tips: Complementary study: While Duolingo is a great tool for beginners, it’s essential to complement it with other learning methods for a well-rounded language education.

oet.desc: Stands for the Occupational English Test. It’s a specialized English language test specifically designed for healthcare professionals who want to work in English-speaking countries. Unlike general English tests like IELTS or TOEFL, OET focuses on the language skills required for real-world medical situations.
oet.summary: English language test designed specifically for healthcare professionals.
oet.mode: Paper-based, Computer-based at test venue, or OET@Home
oet.scoring: OET uses a grading system of A, B, C+ and C. A is the highest grade, and C is the minimum passing grade required for most registration and visa purposes.
oet.contactHeading: Are you a doctor or nurse preparing for OET? Reach out to us for specialized clinical coaching schedules and mock exams.

sections.desc: Medical texts and documents

sections.name: Writing
sections.desc: Medical reports and letters

Industry-Specific Language: OET tests the language skills needed in healthcare settings, making it more relevant to the profession.

gre.desc: The GRE General Test is a key admission requirement for graduate programs (MS, MBA, PhD) globally, particularly in the United States. It evaluates your verbal reasoning, quantitative reasoning, and analytical writing skills, providing admission panels with a common measure for comparing applicants' qualifications.
gre.summary: Standardized admission test for graduate programs and business schools globally.
gre.mode: Computer-delivered at test center or Home Edition
gre.scoring: 130-170 for Verbal, 130-170 for Quantitative, and 0-6 for Analytical Writing
gre.contactHeading: Unsure about GRE score requirements for MS/MBA programs, or want to register for a diagnostic test? Reach out!

usmle.desc: The USMLE is a three-step examination for medical licensure in the United States. It is sponsored by the Federation of State Medical Boards (FSMB) and the National Board of Medical Examiners (NBME). For international medical graduates (IMGs), passing USMLE Steps and securing ECFMG certification is required to enter US residency programs.
usmle.summary: The medical licensing pathway to practice medicine and secure residency in the USA.
usmle.mode: Computer-based testing at Prometric centers globally
usmle.validity: Varies (typically steps must be completed within a 7-year window)
usmle.scoring: Step 1: Pass/Fail; Step 2 CK & Step 3: Three-digit numeric score (passing score is typically around 214+ for Step 2 CK)
usmle.contactHeading: Ready to start your USMLE roadmap? Let us connect you with matched medical mentors and customize your calendar.

sections.desc: 280 multiple-choice questions assessing foundational science concepts, organ systems, and mechanisms of therapy (Pass/Fail).

sections.name: Step 2 CK
sections.desc: 318 multiple-choice questions assessing clinical knowledge, diagnosis, health promotion, and clinical science.

sections.name: Step 3
sections.desc: Computer-based questions and Computer-based Case Simulations (CCS) assessing ability to practice medicine unsupervised.

Step 1 focuses on foundational systems; Step 2 CK focuses on clinical application

plab.desc: The PLAB test is the primary route for international medical graduates (IMGs) to demonstrate they have the necessary skills and knowledge to practice medicine in the United Kingdom. Passing the PLAB exam allows you to apply for General Medical Council (GMC) registration with a license to practice.

neet.desc: NEET (UG & PG) is the sole medical entrance exam in India. Crucially, the Medical Council of India (MCI) / National Medical Commission (NMC) mandates that any Indian student intending to pursue MBBS or equivalent medical degrees abroad must qualify in NEET (UG) to be eligible for GMC/NMC registration upon return.
neet.summary: Qualifying exam for medical education in India and for pursuing MBBS abroad.
neet.scoring: Total of 720 marks (NEET-UG) with +4 for correct and -1 for incorrect answers
neet.contactHeading: Planning to qualify NEET and study MBBS in Georgia, Europe or Philippines? We can guide you on the criteria and university selection.
